description.en: Fills the given arrays with the default gameplay (RPG-mode) camera position and reference point for a character, e.g. to restore the normal follow-camera after a cutscene.
Character handle the RPG camera follows.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] camera position; passed by reference and filled in place.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] look-at reference; passed by reference and filled in place.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Read the default gameplay camera position/reference for a character
CMND_GET_RPG_CAMERA_POS(hchr, pos, ref);
